title: BlockMark
description: It is a client based version of the real WayPoints.
body:
BlockMark – Your Ultimate Minecraft Waypoints Mod

Never get lost again with BlockMark! Easily create, manage, and navigate waypoints in your Minecraft world. Mark your favorite locations, and track distances at a glance. Ideal for explorers, builders, and adventurers alike.

Features:

Create unlimited custom waypoints with unique names.

Color-coded waypoints and optional icons.

Distance display from your current location.

Optional teleportation to waypoints.

Waypoints persist across sessions and can be shared with friends.

User-friendly CUI for quick waypoint management.

With BlockMark, every base, mine, and hidden treasure is just a mark away. Stay oriented, explore freely, and never lose your way!
